label: Fires at D1 after a rare-rewarded a2->S1 trial that followed an unrewarded S2 trial.
short_terms: (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S1 r") * (tv("state", -2) - tv("reward", -2) == 2) ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S1 r") ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S1 r") * (tv("reward", -3) == 0)
terms: (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S1 r") * (tv("reward", -2) == 0) ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S1 r") * (tv("state", -2) == 2) ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S1 r") * (tv("state", -2) == 2) * (tv("reward", -2) == 0) ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S1 r") * belief_lo ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S1 r") * (tv("reward", -3) == 0) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_reward == 1) * (tv("reward", -2) == 0) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_reward == 1) * (tv("state", -2) != prev_state) ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S1 r") * belief_cover
explanation: Active only at D1 (zero at GO/D2). Its magnitude is driven by the previous trial being a2 -> S1 (rare) rewarded, and is much larger (weight ~0.22 vs ~0.01) when the trial before that reached S2 and went unrewarded; i.e. consecutive evidence that S2 is bad and S1 is good, in the form that calls for a model-based switch to a1. Further unrewarded trial three back adds a little. The term tv(state,-2) - tv(reward,-2) == 2 encodes S2-unrewarded as one factor. Other rewarded D1s (a1 S1 r, a1 S2 r, window-first trials) are mostly near zero, though some isolated large firings after other rewarded patterns stay unexplained (these are the worst misses). Belief log-odds, belief cover and generic reward-after-no-reward terms add almost nothing; the free fit (8 terms, dev 0.484) matches the short form (dev 0.485). All terms are observed; no model outputs or future variables.

issues: Minor: the main term carries almost all the signal. The single term (phase==D1)*last_is('a2 S1 r')*(state-2 minus reward-2 == 2) alone scores test 0.486. Adding the other two terms brings it to 0.506. last_is('a2 S1 r') alone scores 0.220.
The S2-unrewarded conjunction is needed. Rewarded-at-2 == 0 alone scores 0.369 and state-2 == S2 alone scores 0.249, against 0.486 for the conjunction. This supports the label.
The effect is specific to a2 S1 r and has no mirror image. Adding the a1 S2 r after S1-unrewarded term gives no gain (test 0.5056). Also, the residual after a1 S2 r is negative in the profile.

No systematic misses. The mean error by phase is at most 0.004. The worst misses are scattered large D1 firings, mostly at the first trial of a window, where the previous trial is unknown, plus a few isolated firings after other patterns. The explanation already admits these.
